labels.en: * %d uploaded halal certificate(s) are omitted from this report — the halal certificate is issued by this body; submitted copies are reviewed on the audit screen.

labels.ko: 총 %d건 · 인증번호 미확보 %d건 — 번호 대조는 오디터가 수행합니다.
labels.en: %d on file · %d without a certificate number — verification of the numbers is performed by the auditor.
labels.id: %d tercatat · %d tanpa nomor sertifikat — verifikasi nomor dilakukan oleh auditor.

labels.id: %d total · diblokir %d · perlu bukti %d · sesuai %d · risiko najis %d

labels.ko: ※ 본 보고서는 AI 온톨로지 기반 준비용 분석이며, 공식 판정은 BPJPH/MUI Fatwa 절차로 확정됩니다.
labels.en: * This report is a preparatory analysis based on an AI ontology. Official determination is made through the BPJPH/MUI Fatwa process.
labels.id: * Laporan ini merupakan analisis persiapan berbasis ontologi AI. Penetapan resmi ditentukan melalui proses BPJPH/MUI Fatwa.

labels.ko: 할랄 전용 라인·세척(사무) 절차로 관리 — 제품 성분이 아님
labels.en: Managed by a dedicated halal line and cleaning (sanitation) procedure — not a product ingredient
labels.id: Dikelola melalui lini khusus halal dan prosedur pembersihan (sanitasi) — bukan bahan produk

labels.ko: 사업자등록증(NIB) 스캔본 — 회사명·NIB 번호·사업장 주소가 판독 가능해야 함
labels.en: Scan of the business licence (NIB) — company name, NIB number and business address must be legible
labels.id: Pindaian izin usaha (NIB) — nama perusahaan, nomor NIB, dan alamat usaha harus terbaca

labels.ko: 공장등록증 — 공장 등록번호와 공장 소재지 주소 포함
labels.en: Factory registration — must include the factory registration number and the factory address
labels.id: Registrasi pabrik — memuat nomor registrasi pabrik dan alamat lokasi pabrik

labels.ko: 인증 대상 전(全) 제품 목록 — 제품명·분류·등록유형(신규/기존 등)
labels.en: Full list of products to be certified — product name, category and registration type (new/existing)
labels.id: Daftar lengkap produk yang disertifikasi — nama produk, kategori, dan jenis pendaftaran (baru/lama)

labels.ko: 제조 공정 흐름도 — 원료입고→배합→가열→충전→포장 등 단계 순서
labels.en: Production process flowchart — the sequence of steps: material intake → mixing → heating → filling → packaging, etc.
labels.id: Diagram alir proses produksi — urutan tahapan: penerimaan bahan → pencampuran → pemanasan → pengisian → pengemasan, dll.

labels.en: Full list of raw materials — material name, supplier and halal status (certified/declared)
labels.id: Daftar lengkap bahan baku — nama bahan, pemasok, dan status halal (bersertifikat/deklarasi)

labels.ko: 임계 원재료 공급사가 받은 할랄 인증서 사본 — 이 플랫폼이 발급하는 인증서가 아니라 신청자가 제출하는 입력 서류다(해당 원재료가 있는 경우)
labels.en: Copies of the halal certificates held by the suppliers of critical raw materials — these are documents the applicant submits, not certificates this platform issues (only where such materials exist)
labels.id: Salinan sertifikat halal yang dimiliki pemasok bahan kritis — ini dokumen yang diunggah pemohon, bukan sertifikat yang diterbitkan platform ini (hanya bila bahan tersebut ada)

labels.en: SJPH manual — must cover all five elements (management commitment, materials, process, product, monitoring)
labels.id: Manual SJPH — mencakup lima elemen (komitmen manajemen, bahan, proses, produk, pemantauan)

labels.ko: 소규모 자기선언 — NIB로 갈음(별도 공장등록증 요구 없음)
labels.en: Small-scale self-declare — covered by the NIB (no separate factory registration required)
labels.id: Self-declare skala kecil — dicakup oleh NIB (tidak perlu registrasi pabrik terpisah)

labels.ko: 인도네시아 소규모 사업자 — NIB가 시설 등록을 겸함(별도 공장등록증 제도 없음)
labels.en: Indonesian micro/small business — the NIB also serves as facility registration (no separate factory registration scheme)
labels.id: Usaha mikro/kecil Indonesia — NIB sekaligus berfungsi sebagai registrasi fasilitas (tidak ada skema registrasi pabrik terpisah)

labels.ko: 인도네시아 자기선언 경로 — 공급사 인증번호로 갈음(BPJPH 대조)
labels.en: Indonesian self-declare pathway — satisfied by the supplier certificate numbers (verified against BPJPH)
labels.id: Jalur self-declare Indonesia — dipenuhi dengan nomor sertifikat pemasok (dicocokkan dengan BPJPH)

labels.ko: 공급사 인증번호 %d건 확보 — 원본 서류 미제출(번호 대조는 오디터)
labels.en: %d supplier certificate numbers on file — original documents not submitted (the auditor verifies the numbers)
labels.id: %d nomor sertifikat pemasok tersedia — dokumen asli belum diunggah (auditor yang mencocokkan nomor)
Draf AI — keputusan ada pada auditor

labels.ko: 공급사 할랄 인증번호 %s (%s) 보유 — 번호가 유효하면 유래 증빙을 갈음할 수 있습니다.
labels.en: Supplier halal certificate no. %s (%s) on file — a valid number can stand in for origin evidence.
labels.id: Nomor sertifikat halal pemasok %s (%s) tersedia — nomor yang sah dapat menggantikan bukti asal-usul.

labels.ko: 인증번호 %s 보유 — 발급기관을 확인해야 효력을 판단할 수 있습니다.
labels.en: Certificate no. %s on file — the issuing body must be confirmed.
labels.id: Nomor sertifikat %s tersedia — lembaga penerbit perlu dipastikan.

labels.en: No certificate number submitted for this material.
labels.id: Tidak ada nomor sertifikat untuk bahan ini.

labels.en: An evidence file has been submitted.

labels.ko: 인증번호를 발급기관 조회로 대조하고, 유효하면 증빙으로 등록해 해제하세요.
labels.en: Verify the number with the issuing body; if valid, register it as evidence to clear.
labels.id: Cocokkan nomor dengan lembaga penerbit; bila sah, daftarkan sebagai bukti untuk melepas status.

labels.ko: 필요 증빙을 받아 등록하면 자동으로 해제됩니다.
labels.en: Collect and register the required evidence to clear automatically.
labels.id: Kumpulkan dan daftarkan bukti yang diperlukan agar status terlepas otomatis.

labels.ko: 금지 성분입니다. 대체재로 바꾸지 않으면 인증할 수 없습니다.
labels.en: Forbidden ingredient — certification is impossible without substitution.
labels.id: Bahan haram — sertifikasi tidak mungkin tanpa penggantian.

labels.ko: 사전에 없는 재료라 안전측으로 증빙필요로 두었습니다(모르는 것을 통과시키지 않습니다).
labels.en: Not in the dictionary, so it was kept as 'evidence required' on the safe side.
labels.id: Tidak ada di kamus, jadi tetap 'perlu bukti' demi keamanan.

labels.ko: ‘%s’은(는) %s 계열 성분이며, 기본 할랄 상태는 %s입니다. (주요 유래: %s)
labels.en: '%s' belongs to the %s category; its baseline halal status is %s. (Main sources: %s)
labels.id: '%s' termasuk kategori %s; status halal dasarnya %s. (Sumber utama: %s)

labels.ko: • 부정물(najis) 위험 성분 — 설비·공정의 할랄 전용/세척(사무 khusus) 이슈가 동반됩니다.
labels.en: • Najis-risk ingredient — requires dedicated halal lines or ritual cleansing (samak) of equipment and process.
labels.id: • Bahan berisiko najis — memerlukan lini khusus halal atau pencucian (samak) pada peralatan dan proses.

labels.ko: • 캐리어/용매 점검 대상(%s) — 향료·색소 등의 용매로 알코올/젤라틴이 쓰였는지 확인 필요.
labels.en: • Carrier/solvent check required (%s) — verify that alcohol or gelatin is not used as a solvent for flavors or colorants.
labels.id: • Perlu pemeriksaan pembawa/pelarut (%s) — pastikan alkohol atau gelatin tidak dipakai sebagai pelarut perisa atau pewarna.

labels.ko: → 판정: 금지(haram). 사용 시 인증 불가 — 대체재로 재설계가 필요합니다.
labels.en: → Verdict: haram. Cannot be certified while in use — reformulation with an alternative is required.
labels.id: → Putusan: haram. Tidak dapat disertifikasi selama digunakan — perlu reformulasi dengan bahan alternatif.

labels.ko: → 판정: 증빙 필요 — 유래(동물/식물)에 따라 할랄 여부가 갈립니다. 아래 증빙 제출 시 CLEARED로 전환됩니다.
labels.en: → Verdict: evidence required — halal status depends on the source (animal/plant). It becomes CLEARED once the evidence below is submitted.
labels.id: → Putusan: perlu bukti — status halal bergantung pada sumber (hewani/nabati). Akan menjadi CLEARED setelah bukti di bawah diserahkan.

labels.ko: → 판정: 할랄 허용(추가 증빙 불요 또는 확보됨).
labels.en: → Verdict: halal (no further evidence needed, or already secured).
labels.id: → Putusan: halal (tanpa bukti tambahan, atau bukti sudah tersedia).

labels.ko: ‘%s’은(는) 온톨로지 정식 등재 성분이 아니며, v1 규칙/키워드 기반으로 ‘%s’ 판정되었습니다.
labels.en: '%s' is not formally registered in the ontology; the verdict '%s' comes from the v1 rule/keyword screen.
labels.id: '%s' belum terdaftar resmi dalam ontologi; putusan '%s' berasal dari aturan/kata kunci v1.

labels.ko: • 미등재 성분은 할랄로 간주하지 않습니다 — 유래·조성 확인 후 판정합니다.
labels.en: • An ingredient absent from the ontology is not treated as halal — the verdict follows verification of its source and composition.
labels.id: • Bahan yang belum terdaftar dalam ontologi tidak dianggap halal — putusan ditetapkan setelah sumber dan komposisinya diverifikasi.

labels.en: Number of outlets over the limit
